votes.yes: More homes allowed near the L and busy bus routes, with less required parking.
Created a city-backed fund to build mixed-income homes the city keeps owning.
Let more single-family areas opt into backyard and basement apartments.
Allowed extra height in some B3 and C3 districts.
Raised the share of affordable homes required in new buildings that need city help or a zoning change.

votes.t: Demolition fee near the 606 and in Pilsen
votes.yes: Charged a fee to tear down homes in those areas, to slow teardowns of older, cheaper buildings.
The Council's own budget, without the Mayor's head tax.
The 2025 budget, with new taxes including a higher cloud tax.
